items.name: lightdict
items.description: 划词即查的轻量 Chrome 词典扩展：选中单词看释义与音标，选中句子看翻译，还能把整个英文网页翻成中英对照。Manifest V3，零依赖，无需构建。

items.name: LightDicom
items.description: DicomLite Viewer — a lightweight, web-based DICOM viewer for fast medical image review. Built with .NET microservices and an Angular frontend, it streams studies directly from S3-compatible object storage (AWS S3, MinIO) and runs anywhere Docker does. Minimal footprint, quick startup, and easy to self-host.
